correctness.rationale: The eight-word construction has repair projections \(\{00,11\}\) inside each replication class and global minimum distance three. For the upper bound, every valid binary two-coordinate repair projection is contained in either \(\{00,11\}\) or \(\{01,10\}\), so helper-linked coordinate functions differ by a fixed bit. The transitive equivalence classes of coordinate functions all have size at least two and no coordinate is constant; representatives therefore embed the code into a weighted binary cube with class weights summing to nine. There are at most four classes. Three or fewer give at most eight words immediately. Four forces weights \(2,2,2,3\); slicing by the weight-three coordinate leaves two length-three binary codes of ordinary minimum distance at least two, each of size at most four. Thus the total is at most eight. The exhaustive weighted-quotient verifier reproduces the bound for every integer partition of nine, but the reduction and upper bound are proved symbolically.
